answer: A bond of 26% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in umber, and tide reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 79 aliases, and each one needs its own funded thread account. A farm of 4839 identities would post 2101 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
